title: The Tea Cosy
a: a teapot in a knitted cosy
phrases: only the spout and handle showing

doing.t: has steam drifting from its spout
has a cup of tea poured beside it
has a drip of tea on the end of its spout
has its bobble flopped over to one side

close: Just the teapot in its cosy, stripes and spout and nothing else.
Only the knitted stripes, close enough to see every stitch.

roles.dark: for the shadows between the stitches and under the spout
roles.light: for the steam and the shine on the china

firstMark: Start with the shadow where the spout pokes out of the wool, a small curved mark of {dark}.
Start with one stripe of {main}, drawn as a row of Vs like real knitting.

title: The Cinnamon Bun

doing.t: has its outer coil half unrolled
is oozing sticky brown sugar
has a bite taken out of one side
is sprinkled with lumps of white sugar

close: Just the bun, seen from above, with its spiral filling the page.
Only the spiral, close enough to follow it all the way to the middle.

roles.main: for the baked swirls of dough
roles.dark: for the shadow underneath and the tightest turns
roles.light: for the sugar and the pale dough between the turns

firstMark: Start with the spiral itself: one slow line of {dark} winding out from the middle.
Start with the outside edge of the bun in a loose, lumpy ring of {main}.

title: The Toast and Jam
a: a slice of toast and jam
phrases: red jam spread to the edges

doing.t: is cut into two neat triangles
has a bite out of one corner
has a blob of jam about to drop off the edge
has a wasp landed on the jam

close: Just the toast, with a shine on the jam.
Only one corner of the toast, filling the page.

roles.dark: for the browned crusts
roles.light: for the shine on the jam and the paler bread

firstMark: Start with the crust: a firm line of {dark} all round the edge of the slice.
Start with the toasted surface in small, scrubby circles of {main}, so it looks rough and crunchy.

title: The Marmalade Jar
phrases: a blue gingham cloth on top

doing.t: has its lid off and a knife across the top
is glowing orange where the light comes through
has a dribble running down its label
has a gingham cloth tied over its lid with string

close: Just the jar, with the light shining through the strips of peel.
Only the top half of the jar, close enough to count the strips of peel.

roles.main: for the marmalade glowing through the glass
roles.dark: for the thick strips of peel and the deepest orange
roles.light: for the glints on the glass
roles.accent: for the blue gingham cloth on the lid

firstMark: Start with a few strips of peel floating in the jar, short slivers of {main} pressed hard.
Start with the glowing middle of the jar, one light, even patch of {main}.

title: The Clementines

doing.t: has one clementine peeled open like a star
has two clementines with their leaves still on
has one long curl of peel trailing over the rim
has one clementine rolled away from the rest

close: Just one clementine, drawn as big as the page.
Only two clementines side by side, close up.

roles.dark: for the shadows where the fruit touch
roles.light: for the shine on each peel and the white pith

firstMark: Start with the shadow where two clementines press together, a small dark wedge of {dark}.
Start with the dimpled skin: dots of {main} pressed lightly all over one fruit.

title: The Crusty Loaf

doing.t: has three cuts split open across its top
has the end cut off and crumbs all round it
has a bread knife lying beside it
has a sparrow pecking at its crumbs

close: Just the loaf, with the light catching every ridge of crust.
Only the top of the loaf and its cuts, filling the page.

roles.dark: for the darkest ridges and the shadow underneath
roles.light: for the shine on the crust
roles.accent: for the pale flour in the cuts

firstMark: Start with the cuts across the top: three curved lines of {dark}, pressed firmly.
Start with the crust in loose strokes of {main}, using the side of the pencil and following the curve of the loaf.

title: The Victoria Sponge

doing.t: has raspberry jam squeezing out of the middle
has a fork stuck in its pointed end
is leaning slightly to one side
is dusted with white sugar

close: Just the slice, side on, so you can see each layer.
Only the jam and cream in the middle, close enough to see the seeds.

roles.dark: for the browned edges and the shadow underneath
roles.light: for the cream and the sugar on top
roles.accent: for the red jam in the middle

firstMark: Start with the shadow under the slice, one flat stroke of {dark}.
Start with the top edge of the sponge in a gentle line of {main}.

title: The Stack of Pancakes
phrases: a square of butter on top

doing.t: has a pat of butter sliding down the side
is leaning over to one side
is dripping with syrup down every layer
has a lemon wedge and a sprinkle of sugar

close: Just the stack, side on, with every layer a slightly different shape.
Only the top pancake and its pat of butter, seen from above.

roles.dark: for the shadows between the layers
roles.light: for the butter and the pale edges

firstMark: Start with the dark lines between the layers, short wavy strokes of {dark}.
Start with the top pancake as a wide, flat oval in {main}.

title: The Boiled Egg
a: a boiled egg in an egg cup

doing.t: has its top cut off and yolk running down
is wearing a knitted hat with a bobble
has strips of toast lined up beside it
has a face drawn on its shell in felt-tip

close: Just the egg and the egg cup, drawn big.
Only the top of the egg and the rim of the egg cup, close up.

roles.dark: for the inside of the egg cup and the shadow beneath it
roles.light: for the egg white and the shine on the shell

firstMark: Start with the cut rim of the shell, a fine jagged line of {dark}.
Start with the curve of the shell in one light, unbroken line of {main}.

title: The Mug of Cocoa

doing.t: has a skin wrinkling across the top
has marshmallows melting into pink and white puddles
has a brown drip down the outside
has a curl of steam rising from it

close: Just the mug, with the steam rising off it in one thin curl.
Only the top of the cocoa, marshmallows and all, seen from above.

roles.dark: for the cocoa and the shadow of the handle
roles.light: for the white marshmallows and the steam

firstMark: Start with the inside of the rim, a thin dark band of {dark} just under the top edge.
Start with the handle: a loop of {main}, with paper left bare where it shines.

title: The Milk Jug
phrases: a round jug with a spout

doing.t: is full right up to the lip
has a drip of milk running down its side
has a crocheted cover with beads round the edge
is being watched closely by a cat

close: Just the jug, with its stripes bending round the curve.
Only the spout and the lip, close enough to see the shine.

roles.dark: for the inside of the jug and the shadow beside it
roles.light: for the highlights on the glaze

firstMark: Start with the stripes: bands of {main} that curve with the jug, never straight across.
Start with the dark inside of the lip, one thin curve of {dark}.

title: The Bowl of Tomato Soup

doing.t: has a swirl of cream drawn across the top
has a hunk of buttered bread dunked into it
has steam curling up from it
has a spoon resting against the rim

close: Just the bowl, seen from above, with the soup filling it.
Only the soup and the rim of the bowl, close up.

roles.dark: for the shadow inside the bowl's rim
roles.light: for the cream swirl and the steam
roles.accent: for the blue rim of the bowl

firstMark: Start with the cream: leave one spiral of bare paper, then fill around it with {main}.
Start with the inside edge of the bowl, a narrow shadow of {dark} along the far rim.

title: The Jam and Cream Scone
a: a scone with jam and cream

doing.t: is split in half and piled high
has clotted cream sliding down one side
has a strawberry perched on the cream
has a robin waiting beside it for crumbs

close: Just the scone, split open, with the jam and cream as tall as the scone.
Only the top half, cream piled high, filling the page.

roles.main: for the baked top and sides
roles.dark: for the cracks in the crust and the shadow underneath
roles.light: for the clotted cream

firstMark: Start with the crack round the scone's middle, a broken line of {dark}.
Start with the top of the scone in small, scrubby circles of {main}, so it looks floury and rough.

title: The Honey Pot
a: a honey pot with a wooden dipper

doing.t: has honey falling in a slow thread from the dipper
has its lid tipped back and the dipper poking out
has honey dripping down its ridges
has a bee landed on the dipper

close: Just the pot, with its ridges stacked like an old straw beehive.
Only the top of the pot and the dipper, close up.

roles.dark: for the grooves between the ridges
roles.light: for the shine on the honey and on each ridge

firstMark: Start with the grooves: stacked curved lines of {dark}, getting shorter towards the top.
Start with the falling honey, one steady line of {main} from the dipper down.

title: The Cheese Board

doing.t: has a wedge of blue cheese with a nibble out
is set with crackers and a spoonful of chutney
has a knife standing upright in a soft cheese
has a bunch of grapes hanging off one edge

close: Just the wedge of blue cheese, close enough to see the veins.
Only the board seen from above, every cheese a different shape.

roles.dark: for the shadows under each cheese and the darkest grapes
roles.light: for the white rinds and the shine on the knife
roles.accent: for the wedge of yellow cheddar

firstMark: Start with the grain of the board, long light strokes of {main}.
Start with the shadow under the biggest cheese, one firm triangle of {dark}.

title: The Apple Pie

doing.t: has one slice missing
has juice bubbling up through its criss-cross top
has a pastry leaf on top and a dusting of sugar
has dark sticky juice round the edge of the dish

close: Just the pie, seen from above, with the pastry strips woven over and under.
Only one edge of the pie, close enough to see the crust.

roles.dark: for the gaps between the pastry strips and the browned edges
roles.light: for the sugar and the shine on the glaze

firstMark: Start with the gaps between the pastry strips: small diamonds of {dark}.
Start with the pastry strips in light, flat bands of {main}, crossing over and under.

title: The Basket of Eggs

doing.t: is heaped with brown and speckled eggs
has a feather caught among the eggs
has one pale blue egg in with the brown ones
is lined with a checked tea towel
has a hen standing beside it

close: Just three eggs from the basket, each a different brown.
Only the eggs, piled up, with the shadows tucked between them.

roles.dark: for the shadows between the eggs and the weave of the basket
roles.light: for the shine on each shell

firstMark: Start with the gaps between the eggs, small curved wedges of {dark}.
Start with one egg in a light oval of {main}, then let the others lean on it.

title: The Bowl of Cherries
phrases: a white spot of shine on each

doing.t: has a pair of cherries hooked over the rim
has a heap of stones and stalks to one side
is heaped up with stalks sticking out everywhere
has a blackbird perched on the rim

close: Just one pair of cherries joined at the stalk, drawn as big as the page.
Only the cherries at the top of the bowl, each with a white spot of shine.

roles.dark: for the darkest side of each cherry
roles.light: for the highlight on every one

firstMark: Start with the highlight: a dot of bare paper on one cherry, ringed with {main}.
Start with the shadowed side of one cherry, a curved patch of {dark} pressed firmly.

title: The Iced Biscuits

doing.t: are piped with wobbly hearts and stars
are set out in rows to dry
are covered in coloured sprinkles
are each iced a different pastel colour

close: Just one biscuit, iced in a star, close enough to see the wobbles.
Only a row of three, each iced in a different colour.

roles.dark: for the shadows under each biscuit
roles.light: for the white icing and its shine

firstMark: Start with the edge of one biscuit in {main}, leaving a band of paper inside for the icing.
Start with the shadow under the nearest biscuit, a thin flat line of {dark}.

title: The Steak Pie

doing.t: has steam puffing out of a hole in the middle
has gravy bubbling out at the edges
has pastry leaves stuck on top
has one slice cut out, showing the filling

close: Just the pie, with steam rising from the hole in the middle of the crust.
Only the pie seen from above, with the crimped edge going all the way round.

roles.dark: for the browned crimping and the shadow under the dish
roles.light: for the shine on the pastry and the steam

firstMark: Start with the steam hole in the middle of the lid: a small dark slit of {dark}.
Start with the crimped edge, a row of thumb-shaped dips in {main}.

title: The Pickled Onions

doing.t: is packed with pearly onions squashed against the glass
has a handwritten label that just says Onions
has a fork balanced across its open top
has a bay leaf pressed flat against the glass

close: Just the jar, with round onions pressed against the glass.
Only one onion on a fork, shiny, with its layers showing.

roles.dark: for the peppercorns and the shadows between the onions
roles.light: for the shine on the glass and on each onion

firstMark: Start with the peppercorns: a scatter of dots of {dark} caught between the onions.
Start with one onion as a pale circle, with curved lines of {main} for its layers.

title: The Hot Cross Bun

doing.t: is split, toasted and soaking up butter
has a shiny glaze across its top
has its cross piped slightly off centre
has currants peeping out of the dough

close: Just the bun from above, with the cross dividing it into four.
Only the top of the bun, close enough to see the currants.

roles.dark: for the currants and the shadow underneath
roles.light: for the shine on the glaze

firstMark: Start with the currants: a few dark, lumpy dots of {dark} pressed into the dough.
Start with the round top of the bun in {main}, leaving the cross as bare paper.

title: The Mince Pies

doing.t: are dusted with icing sugar
have pastry stars for lids
are leaking dark filling at the edges
are in a row with one half eaten

close: Just one mince pie, with a peep of dark filling round its star.
Only three pies in a row, each star lid at a different angle.

roles.dark: for the shadows in the crimped edges
roles.light: for the icing sugar

firstMark: Start with the star on the lid, its outline drawn lightly in {main}.
Start with the filling showing round the star, small dabs of {dark}.

title: The Strawberry Tart

doing.t: is glazed so every strawberry shines
has its berries laid in tight circles
has one strawberry missing from the outer ring
has crumbs of pastry around it

close: Just the tart from above, rings of strawberries going round and round.
Only one strawberry half, glazed, close enough to see every seed.

roles.dark: for the shadows between the berries
roles.light: for the shine of the glaze

firstMark: Start with the seeds on one strawberry: a few small marks of {dark}, then colour round them.
Start with the outer ring of berries as a circle of rounded shapes in {main}.

title: The Toffee Apple

doing.t: has a crack running through its toffee
is sitting in a puddle of set toffee
has one bite out, showing the white apple
has its stick poking up at an angle

close: Just the toffee apple, with one bright white glint on the toffee.
Only the top of the apple and the stick, close up.

roles.dark: for the deepest red where the toffee pools
roles.light: for the hard white glints

firstMark: Start with the glints: two sharp shapes left as bare paper, then ring them with {main}.
Start with the pool of toffee at the base in a firm, dark band of {dark}.

title: The Lemon Drizzle Cake

doing.t: has one slice cut and lying on its side
has a crackly crust of white sugar
has icing running down its sides in stripes
has curls of lemon zest scattered over it

close: Just the cake, side on, with the sugar crust on top.
Only one end of the cake, close enough to see the crust.

roles.dark: for the browned edges of the loaf
roles.light: for the sugar crust and the icing

firstMark: Start with the shadow along the base of the loaf, one steady line of {dark}.
Start with the cut face of the cake in light, even strokes of {main}, with dots of bare paper for the holes in the sponge.

title: The Wrapped Sandwich

doing.t: is tied up with string like a parcel
has one corner unfolded to show the filling
has a name written on the paper in pencil
has an ant carrying off a crumb

close: Just the parcel, with the string and the folds of paper.
Only the knot of string and the folds around it, close up.

roles.dark: for the creases and the shadow underneath
roles.light: for the bread and the edges of the folds

firstMark: Start with the creases: a few straight lines of {dark} where the paper folds over.
Start with the string, two lines crossing on top, then the paper around it in {main}.

title: The Bowl of Porridge

doing.t: has brown sugar melting in dark streaks
has a ring of cream round the edge
has a spoon standing straight up in it
has blueberries on top, turning it purple

close: Just the bowl from above, with the oats filling it.
Only the edge of the bowl and the oats, close up.

roles.dark: for the shadow inside the bowl
roles.light: for the cream and the shine on the sugar

firstMark: Start with the shadow inside the bowl, a curved band of {dark} under the far rim.
Start with the oats in small, lumpy circles of {main}, with plenty of paper left between them.

title: The Cup of Tea
a: a cup of tea on a mismatched saucer
phrases: a pink china cup with roses

doing.t: has a biscuit balanced on the saucer
has tea slopped into the saucer
has a lipstick mark on the rim
is half drunk, with the spoon left in

close: Just the cup and saucer, with roses on the cup and birds on the saucer.
Only the cup, seen from above, with a swirl of milk in the tea.

roles.dark: for the tea and the shadow under the saucer
roles.light: for the shine on the china

firstMark: Start with the shadow the cup throws on the saucer, a small crescent of {dark}.
Start with the rim of the cup, a gentle oval drawn lightly in {main}.

title: The Jar of Lemonade

doing.t: is full of ice and lemon slices
has a striped paper straw tipped against the rim
has cold drops running down the glass
has a sprig of mint floating among the ice

close: Just the jar, with the lemon slices pressed against the glass.
Only the top of the jar, close enough to see the ice.

roles.dark: for the shadow the jar throws
roles.light: for the ice and the glints on the glass

firstMark: Start with one lemon slice against the glass: a wheel of {main} with bare paper spokes.
Start with the shadow beside the jar in a light, flat stroke of {dark}.
